source.title: 2018 Salary Resolutions (2018-01-03 Town Board - Packet, CivicClerk)

note: Board-authorized annual salaries set by resolutions 2018-1 through 2018-8. Schedules carried here: Boards, Elected Officials, General Fund, Highway, Police, Sewer / Scavenger Waste, Street Lighting, Water District. This is authorized pay, not actual pay, and it is the schedule as adopted in January: a mid-year salary resolution changes what a position is paid without changing this file.
